spans.s: हंस्तपदा name given to a kind of svarabhakti,when the consonant. र, followed by ष्, is read as र + ष्+ ह्
हनु inside of the chin, mentioned as a स्थान or place which is touched by the tongue when a peculiar sound described as something like किट्-किट् is produced; cf क्रिट्किडाकरो हन्वां तिष्ठति R.
